command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
T0=$(date +%s)
samtools sort -@ 8 -m 1G -T /tmp/st -o hifi.sorted.bam aln.sam.gz 2> sort.log
T1=$(date +%s)
samtools index -@ 8 hifi.sorted.bam
MAGIC=$(od -An -tx1 -N4 hifi.sorted.bam | tr -d ' \n')
QC=0; samtools quickcheck -v hifi.sorted.bam 2>/dev/null && QC=1
NREC=$(samtools view -c -@ 8 hifi.sorted.bam)
samtools coverage -r chr20 hifi.sorted.bam > cov.txt
DEPTH=$(awk 'NR==2{print $7}' cov.txt)
COVPCT=$(awk 'NR==2{print $6}' cov.txt)
{
  echo "sort_wall_s     $(( T1 - T0 ))"
  echo "bam_magic       $MAGIC  want 1f8b0804"
  echo "quickcheck      $QC  want 1"
  echo "records         $NREC"
  echo "mean_depth      $DEPTH  want >=25"
  echo "pct_covered     $COVPCT  want >=98"
  echo "bam_bytes       $(stat -c%s hifi.sorted.bam)"
} > sort-check.txt
cat sort-check.txt; cat cov.txt
test "$MAGIC" = '1f8b0804'; test "$QC" -eq 1
awk -v d="$DEPTH" 'BEGIN{exit !(d>=25)}'
awk -v c="$COVPCT" 'BEGIN{exit !(c>=98)}'
echo 'SORT CHECK PASSED'
